selection.rationale: ROC-AUC measures how well a model ranks survivors above non-survivors across every possible threshold. It is insensitive to the moderate class imbalance (~38% survived) and does not depend on the arbitrary 0.5 cut-off, so it compares the models' underlying discrimination rather than one operating point. Ties are broken by lower cross-validation variance.

feature_descriptions.age: Age in years (median-imputed inside each training fold; a missing-age indicator is added).
feature_descriptions.log_fare: log(1 + fare); reduces the strong right skew of fares.
feature_descriptions.is_child: 1 if age < 16, else 0 (0 when age is unknown). Captures the 'women and children first' threshold that the dropped `who` column encoded.
feature_descriptions.embarked: Port of embarkation (C/Q/S), most-frequent-imputed and one-hot encoded.

excluded_features.who: Deterministic function of `sex` and `age < 16`; replaced by the engineered `is_child` flag plus a missing-age indicator.
excluded_features.alone: Deterministic function of `sibsp + parch == 0`; captured by the engineered `family_size`.
excluded_features.deck: ~77% missing; imputing it would mostly encode missingness, which is itself strongly tied to passenger class.

logistic_regression.description: Regularised linear model on standardised features. Reference model from the original notebook; the notebook did not tune C, which is the most influential hyperparameter, so it is added here.

random_forest.description: Bagged ensemble of decision trees (reference model from the notebook). Search widened from the notebook grid to include leaf size and feature subsampling, which control variance on small data.

decision_tree.description: Single interpretable tree; a transparent baseline for the ensembles.

hist_gradient_boosting.description: Gradient-boosted trees (scikit-learn native, no extra dependency). Typically the strongest tabular learner; tuned conservatively because the training set is small.

svm.description: Finds the boundary between survivors and non-survivors with the widest margin; the RBF kernel allows a smooth curved boundary. Relies on the pipeline's scaling. Probabilities come from internal Platt scaling. C is capped at 30 to keep the linear kernel's training time bounded.
